get.description: Retrieve all available subscription plans with their details, pricing, and features.

durationDays.description: 30 for Starter/Standard, 365 for Annual, null for Free

validFor.description: 30 for Starter/Standard, 365 for Annual, null for Free

get.description: Get the current active subscription details for the authenticated user. Users always have an active plan — if no paid subscription is active, the user automatically falls back to the Free plan.

createdAt.description: When the subscription record was created

dateActivated.description: The date the user subscribed to this plan

validFor.description: 30 for Starter/Standard, 365 for Annual, null for Free

daysLeft.description: Dynamic countdown until 0. When it reaches 0, user falls back to Free plan. null for Free plan.

freeTrialsRemaining.description: Number of free trials remaining (only for Free plan, null for paid plans)

get.description:
Get available upgrade options based on current subscription.
Users cannot downgrade to a lower plan while on an active paid subscription.

post.description:
Initialize a subscription payment.

**FREE plan**: Immediately activates. No Paystack call. Response has redirectRequired=false.
**Paid plans**: Calls Paystack with plan code. Response has redirectRequired=true and authorization_url for redirect.

Plan codes: STARTER=PLN_tc7124mko6gjmuj, STANDARD=PLN_q62tai9tprye3bm, ANNUAL=PLN_ihu5gc5pa3paww2

Hierarchy: FREE < STARTER < STANDARD < ANNUAL. Cannot downgrade while on active paid plan.

paymentMethod.description: Required for paid plans. Optional for FREE.

redirectRequired.description: true for paid plans (redirect to authorization_url), false for FREE plan

400.description: Invalid request or attempting to downgrade

500.description: Payment initialized but authorization_url missing from Paystack response

post.summary: Verify Paystack payment and activate subscription
post.description: Verify a Paystack payment transaction and activate the corresponding subscription. Called after user completes payment on Paystack checkout. The payment reference is verified with Paystack to confirm the transaction was successful.

createdAt.description: When the subscription record was created

400.description: Invalid payment, already processed, or Paystack verification failed
